column1: # LunarArc mapping overrides for Minecraft 1.21.1.
# The complete Paper/Spigot -> Mojang mapping database is generated at build
# time from Mojang's 1.21.1 server mappings plus the pinned Spigot BuildData
# class aliases, and is bundled as mappings/1.21.1/paper-reobf.tiny.
# Keep this file only for genuine hybrid-runtime exceptions that are not
# represented by Paper's mapping data.
# CLASS  <spigot internal name> <mojang internal name>
# FIELD  <spigot owner> <spigot name> <spigot descriptor or *> <mojang name>
# METHOD <spigot owner> <spigot name> <spigot descriptor or *> <mojang name>
# Legacy CraftBukkit unversioned `org.bukkit.craftbukkit.*` NMS bytecode uses ServerPlayer.c for the
# packet listener. Paper remaps this member to Mojang's `connection`.
FIELD
FIELD
# TAB reflects PlayerConnection.sendPacket(Packet), the pre-1.17 NMS name that plugins still
# hardcode for cross-version reflection. It is not an obfuscated name, so it is in neither
# Mojang's mappings nor Spigot's - only this table can carry it. 1.21.1 declares the method as
# send(Packet) on ServerCommonPacketListenerImpl, which PlayerConnection
# (ServerGamePacketListenerImpl) inherits; the resolver walks superclasses, so keying it on the
# owner the bytecode names is enough.
METHOD
